sections.content: En consecuencia, por consiguiente, como consecuencia and por lo tanto all mean roughly 'therefore' — a formal argument keeps rotating between them so the writing doesn't repeat the same connector sentence after sentence. These sentences are taken directly from the previous reading.

items.spanish: En consecuencia, se esperaba que la nueva ciudadanía sustituyera por completo a las viejas jerarquías coloniales.
items.english: As a result, the new citizenship was expected to completely replace the old colonial hierarchies.

items.spanish: Por consiguiente, en la práctica, solo una minoría de hombres adultos ejercía realmente el derecho al voto.
items.english: Consequently, in practice, only a minority of adult men actually exercised the right to vote.

items.spanish: Como consecuencia, la igualdad legal proclamada en el papel convivía con una ciudadanía política profundamente restringida.
items.english: As a consequence, the legal equality proclaimed on paper coexisted with a deeply restricted political citizenship.

items.spanish: Por lo tanto, el propio liberalismo latinoamericano cargó con una tensión no resuelta entre sus principios y sus prácticas.
items.english: Therefore, Latin American liberalism itself carried an unresolved tension between its principles and its practices.

sections.content: All four connectors are interchangeable in meaning, so the real skill is variety: a formal essay that used 'por lo tanto' four times in a row would read as repetitive, even though every sentence would still be grammatically correct.
